# App started (`app_started`)

**Kind:** trigger · **Category:** Apps · **Available in:** personal and machine automations

Fires when an app starts.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `app` | app or list of apps | yes |  | The app(s) that start. Use the exe name (chrome or chrome.exe), a full path (C:\Games\game.exe) or wildcards (*steam*). Use * for any app. |
| `instance` | one of: `first`, `any` | no | `first` | Many apps (browsers, games, Steam) start several processes. 'first' fires only when the first copy starts; 'any' fires for every process. |
| `user` | user or list of users | no |  | Only fire when one of these users start the app. Accepts a user name (samet), DOMAIN\name, a SID, or wildcards (admin*). Leave empty for any user. |

## Example

```yaml
triggers:
  - type: app_started
    app: [steam.exe, epicgameslauncher.exe]
```

## Notes

Detected instantly by the service using Windows event tracing. If the service is not running, the agent falls back to checking the process list every 2 seconds.
